people.note: PROBABLE / MODERATE. Agricultural labourer, of Carnlough. Probable marriage: Thomas Magill married Mary Wilson on 27 Nov 1879 at Glenarm, parish of Tickmacrevan (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-2666378). His father was Jeremiah Magill, a tailor. This is marked probable/moderate because Ellen Magill’s birth has not yet been linked to this couple. Also named as father, a labourer, on the probable 30 Sep 1906 Carnlough marriage of Ellen Magill to Robert Donaghy; a witness was also named Thomas Magill. A competing lead, not added as people: Thomas Magill married Catherine McKendry on 6 Sep 1885 in Larne (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-2341190). Mary McKendry was a witness at the 1906 marriage.
